home: Which app is right for me?

intents.title: What is Healthcare Crown Academy?
intents.answer: We make study and well-being apps for people who work or study in healthcare: students, nurses, healthcare assistants, carers and leaders. One account opens six apps, and every app starts free. We're a UK company (Companies House 17501904), registered with the ICO, with no ads.

intents.title: Which app is right for me?
say: I am a student nurse where do I start
new to this where to begin
intents.answer: Tell me who you are and I'll point you to one place to start:

intents.title: Is it free?
intents.answer: Yes, every app starts free with no card. Free includes: MedLex starter modules, the Carecraft daily scenario and 6 lessons, all of Serein, Lumen study tools, 10 free questions for each Gulf exam and a free Evinca story. Paid passes unlock everything else.

intents.title: Do I need an account?
say: do I need to sign up
intents.answer: Not for most things. MedLex, Carecraft, Serein and Lumen work without signing in, and keep your progress in your browser. You need a free account to buy a plan, to save Gulf exam progress to your account, and for Evinca. One account works for all the apps. You must be 16 or over (18 for Evinca).

intents.title: Is this legit / is it a scam?
intents.answer: Fair question. We're HEALTHCARE CROWN ACADEMY LTD, registered in England and Wales (company 17501904) and with the ICO for data protection (ZC273259); you can check both on the public registers. Payments go through Stripe, so we never see your card. Everything starts free, so you can judge it before paying.

intents.title: Who makes the content? Is it accurate?
intents.answer: The apps are made for healthcare learners by the Academy's founder, Hossam, and the Gulf question bank is clinically reviewed before release. All content is educational: it doesn't replace your training, your employer's policies or your regulator's standards. If you spot something you think is wrong, please tell us so we can check it.

intents.title: What does "Earn your crown" / Daily Crown mean?
intents.answer: The crown is how we show the apps together: each app is a "jewel". The **Daily Crown** on the home page helps you pick where to start. The optional **daily streak** counts the days you learn across the apps; it's off unless you switch it on in your account page.

intents.title: Is there a mobile app? App Store / Google Play?
intents.answer: The apps run in any up-to-date browser, and you can install each one on your phone like an app. **iPhone or iPad:** open the app in Safari, tap **Share**, then **Add to Home Screen**. **Android, or Chrome/Edge on a computer:** use **Install** in the browser menu. There's no separate App Store download yet.

intents.title: Which devices and browsers work?
intents.answer: Any up-to-date browser on a phone, tablet or computer: Chrome, Edge, Safari or Firefox. If something looks wrong, updating the browser fixes most problems.

intents.title: Does it work offline?
intents.answer:
Partly, by app:
- **MedLex** keeps working offline once you've opened it.
- **Carecraft** has a downloadable offline edition.
- **Serein** can be saved for offline use in its settings.
- **Lumen** keeps your library on your device; AI help with your own key needs a connection.
- **Gulf Region Nursing** caches what you've opened; signing in and saving to your account need a connection.

intents.title: Are there ads? Do you track me?
intents.answer: No ads, ever, and no advertising or analytics cookies. If you sign in, one essential cookie keeps you signed in across the apps. We don't sell personal data.

intents.title: Is it in Arabic / other languages?
intents.answer: The apps are in English. Gulf Region Nursing has a bilingual glossary to help with key terms. Crown Help answers in English.

intents.title: Is it accredited? Do I get CPD / a certificate?
intents.answer: Our apps are for learning and practice. They are not accredited and don't give a qualification, registration or licence to practise, and Carecraft is not CPD. Two exceptions with their own certificates: the **Green Belt** gives a Certificate of Completion after its exam, and **Evinca** gives evidence-reviewed recognition records. You can still log your own learning as reflective practice where your regulator allows.

intents.title: Who is it for? I'm not in healthcare.
intents.answer: The apps are built for people who study or work in health and care, but anyone 16 or over can use them. Serein's well-being practices are free for everyone. They are educational, not medical advice.

intents.title: How much does it cost?
intents.answer:
Three simple passes:
- **Crown Pass** (MedLex, Carecraft, Lumen fully unlocked): £5.99 a month or £39.99 a year, with a 7-day free trial.
- **Gulf Pass** (all four Gulf exams + the Crown Pass): US$29 for 1 month, US$50 for 3 months, US$69 for 6 months. Paid once, never renews.
- **Green Belt**: US$99 for 12 months, paid once.
Serein is free for everyone. Prices may be lower in your country.
buttons: Is it cheaper in my country?

intents.title: What's the difference between the passes?
intents.answer: Studying or working in healthcare anywhere: **Crown Pass**. Sitting the Saudi, Qatar, Dubai or Abu Dhabi nursing exam: **Gulf Pass**, which already includes the Crown Pass. Leading quality improvement: **Green Belt** (a separate app with its own sign-in).

intents.title: What's included in the Crown Pass?
say: what do I get with crown pass
intents.answer: The Crown Pass fully unlocks **MedLex** (all 26 modules and 1,480 terms), **Carecraft** (all 30 lessons and 32 activities) and **Lumen** (unlimited sources, recall cards and the focus planner). It also gives 15% off Evinca review fees. Serein is free for everyone anyway.

intents.title: Can I buy just one app?
intents.answer: No, and you don't need to: the Crown Pass gives you every Crown app for one small price, and each app has a free version you can keep using without paying.

intents.title: Is it cheaper in my country?
intents.answer:
Yes, the Crown Pass follows World Bank income groups, set from your billing country at checkout:
- Upper-middle-income (e.g. Jordan, Malaysia, Turkey, South Africa, Brazil): **US$4.49 a month or US$29.99 a year**.
- Lower-middle and low-income (e.g. Egypt, India, Pakistan, the Philippines, Nigeria, Kenya): **US$2.99 a month or US$19.99 a year**.
The Gulf Pass and Green Belt cost the same everywhere. Stripe may show your local currency.

intents.title: What is the founding price?
intents.answer: Join the yearly Crown Pass before **31 January 2027** and your first year is £29.99. It then renews at £39.99 a year, and we remind you before it does. From 1 February 2027, yearly is £49.99 for new members.

dated.answer: The founding offer ended on 31 January 2027. The yearly Crown Pass is now **£49.99 a year** for new members, or £5.99 a month. Members who joined at the founding price keep their renewal price of £39.99 a year.

intents.title: How does the free trial work?
intents.answer: The Crown Pass starts with 7 days free. You add a card and pay £0 today. Your first payment is on day 8, then it renews automatically. Cancel before the trial ends and you aren't charged. We email you a reminder before the trial turns into a paid plan.

intents.title: Do you have student / NHS / discount codes?
intents.answer: You can enter a discount code at checkout if you have one. For student or course pricing, email us with your course and we'll tell you what we can offer.

intents.title: Team, hospital, care home or university pricing
intents.answer: Yes. Teams of 10 or more (care homes, hospitals, nursing schools) get team prices, a **free 30-day pilot** and payment by invoice. Tell us your organisation and team size and we'll come back to you.

intents.title: Is VAT included? Do I get an invoice/receipt?
intents.answer: No VAT is added: the price shown is what you pay. Stripe emails you a receipt after each payment. If you need an invoice with your employer's details, email us with the receipt number.

intents.title: Which payment methods? Currency?
intents.answer: Payment is by card through Stripe's secure checkout. Any other options available in your country (such as Apple Pay or Google Pay) appear on the checkout page. Crown Pass prices are in pounds, or US dollars for country pricing; the Gulf Pass and Green Belt are in US dollars. Your bank may add its own currency fee.

intents.title: Is it worth it? / Too expensive
intents.answer: That's fair to ask. Everything starts free, so you can keep using the free versions as long as you like. If you upgrade, the 7-day trial costs nothing, and you get a full refund if you cancel within 14 days. If you're in a lower-income country, the price is lower at checkout, and you can email us about student pricing.

intents.title: Will the price go up?
intents.answer: The price you agree is fixed for the period you've paid for. If a plan's price changes, it applies only from your next renewal, and we email you at least 30 days before so you can stop renewal at no cost.

intents.title: Payment page says "Test mode"
intents.answer: Sorry for the confusion: payments are still being set up, so the checkout is in test mode and no real money is taken. Please email us and we'll let you know as soon as plans open.

intents.title: How do I cancel?
intents.answer:
Two ways, both from the plans page or your account page:
1. **Stop renewal**, any time: you keep access until the end of the period you paid for. No more payments, no refund.
2. **Cancel and get a refund**, within 14 days of buying or starting your trial: access ends now and you get a full refund.
Your progress is never deleted.

intents.title: Can I get a refund?
intents.answer: Yes, if it's within 14 days of buying or starting your trial: use **Cancel and get a refund** on your account page. You get a full refund even if you've used the apps. It goes back to your card, usually within 5–10 working days. After 14 days we don't refund part-used periods for a change of mind, but you can stop renewal at any time.

intents.title: Refund after 14 days
intents.answer: I understand, that's annoying. After the 14-day period our policy doesn't refund part-used periods for a change of mind, but you can stop renewal now so you're not charged again. If something went wrong on our side (for example, you didn't get a renewal reminder, or the app didn't work as described), please tell our team; they'll look at your case properly.

intents.title: I was charged twice / wrong amount / charged after cancelling
intents.answer: Sorry about that. If we've charged you twice, after you cancelled, or a price you didn't agree, we'll refund it. Please send us the email on your account and the receipt number (from Stripe's email) so we can find the payment quickly.

intents.title: The refund button didn't work / not available
intents.answer: Sorry about that. The instant button covers one refund per person for each product. If it didn't work, or you've used it before, email us before your 14 days end: we apply the same rules and treat the day you emailed as your cancellation date.

intents.title: Where is my refund?
intents.answer: We send refunds within 14 days of you cancelling, and card refunds usually arrive 5–10 working days after they're sent. If it's been longer than that, email us with your receipt number and we'll chase it.

intents.title: I didn't get a receipt / confirmation email
intents.answer: Stripe sends the receipt, and we send an order confirmation. Check your spam or promotions folder for emails from Stripe or Healthcare Crown Academy. Still nothing? Email us the address you paid with and we'll resend it.

intents.title: Update my card / payment failed
intents.answer: Use **Stop renewal or update card** on your account page. It opens Stripe's secure page, where you can change your card. If a payment keeps failing, your bank may be blocking an overseas payment: please check with them.

intents.title: Switch monthly ↔ yearly / upgrade to Gulf Pass
intents.answer: Email us and we'll switch you without paying twice for the same days: we adjust it on our side. If you'd rather do it yourself, stop renewal on your current plan and choose the new one when it ends. Moving to the Gulf Pass? It already includes the Crown Pass for the same time, so tell us and we'll make sure you don't pay for both.

intents.title: Does the Gulf Pass renew?
intents.answer: No. The Gulf Pass is paid once and never renews. The Crown Pass included with it ends at the same time and never turns into a paid subscription.

intents.title: What happens to my progress if I cancel?
intents.answer: Your progress and notes are kept, and the free version stays open to you. Only the paid features lock again.

intents.title: Formal complaint about billing
intents.answer: I'm sorry this has been frustrating. I'll pass this straight to a person so it's sorted properly. We reply within 5 working days, and if we can't resolve it, we'll explain why in writing.

intents.title: How do I sign in / create an account?
intents.answer: Tap **Sign in** at the top of any app or the home page, then create an account with your email and a password. One account works across all the Crown apps and Evinca. (The Green Belt has its own sign-in.)

intents.title: Forgot my password
intents.answer: On the sign-in screen, tap **Forgotten your password?** and enter your email. We'll send a reset link; check spam if it doesn't arrive within a few minutes. Links expire, so use the newest one.

intents.title: "Email and password do not match"
intents.answer:
Usually it's a small typo or a different email. Try:
1. Check the email address (no space at the end).
2. Reset your password with **Forgotten your password?**.
3. Try the email you used when you paid.
Still stuck? Our team can check your account.

intents.title: Reset email never arrives
intents.answer: Check your spam, junk or promotions folder, and wait a few minutes. Make sure you typed the same email you signed up with. If it still doesn't arrive, email us from that address and we'll help.

intents.title: I lost access to my email / want to change my email
intents.answer: For your security, a person needs to do this. Email us from your new address, tell us the old one, and include a receipt number if you've paid, so we can confirm it's you.

intents.title: My plan isn't showing / still locked after paying
intents.answer:
Sorry about that. Try:
1. Make sure you're signed in with the email you paid with.
2. Sign out and back in, then refresh the page.
3. Open your account page and check the plan shows there.
If it still says Free, email us your receipt number and we'll fix it quickly.

intents.title: Does one account work for all apps?
intents.answer: Yes, one account signs you into MedLex, Carecraft, Serein, Lumen, Gulf Region Nursing and Evinca. The **Green Belt** is the exception: it has its own sign-in.

intents.title: Use on multiple devices / my progress isn't on my other device
intents.answer: Your account and plan work on every device. But MedLex, Carecraft, Serein and Lumen keep progress in the browser on that device, so it doesn't follow you automatically. To move it, use the app's **backup / export** and **import** on the new device. Gulf Region Nursing saves progress to your account when you're signed in.

intents.title: Close / delete my account
intents.answer: You can do it yourself: open your account page, then **Close my account**, and type CLOSE to confirm. It deletes your name, profile, learning progress and Academy certificates, stops any renewing plan and ends any Gulf Pass. It can't be undone. Want a refund? Use **Cancel and get a refund** first. We keep payment records without your name for 6 years, as tax law requires.

intents.title: Age: I'm under 16 / under 18
intents.answer: You can create an account from age 16. If you're under 18, a parent or guardian must make any purchase. Evinca is for people aged 18 and over.

intents.title: Unsubscribe from emails
intents.answer: Use the **unsubscribe** link at the bottom of any news email, and you'll be removed straight away. Important emails about a plan you have (receipts, renewal reminders) still come, as the law requires.

intents.title: Daily streak cookie
intents.answer: The daily streak is off unless you switch it on in your account page. When on, it keeps a small cookie with the date, the apps you used and your streak, for up to a year. It's never used for tracking. Switch it off and it's deleted.

intents.title: Where is my data stored?
intents.answer: Most of it stays on your device: MedLex, Carecraft, Serein and Lumen keep your progress, notes and settings in your browser. Your account, plan and Gulf exam progress (when signed in) are stored with Supabase in London. Serein's journal and check-ins never leave your device, and no one at the Academy can read them.

intents.title: Can I put patient information in Lumen / notes?
intents.answer: Please don't. Our apps are for learning, not health records. Remove names, dates of birth, NHS or hospital numbers and any details that could identify someone before you add anything, especially anything sent to an AI provider.

intents.title: Request a copy of my data / data rights
intents.answer: You can ask to access, correct, delete, restrict or export your data, or object to its use. Email us with "Data request" in the subject from your account's email address. We reply within one month.

intents.title: Data protection complaint
intents.answer: I'm sorry you're unhappy with how we've handled your data. Please email us with "Data protection complaint" in the subject: we acknowledge within 30 days, investigate and tell you the outcome. You can also contact the ICO at ico.org.uk/make-a-complaint or 0303 123 1113.

intents.title: Do you use AI? Is my data used to train AI?
intents.answer: We don't provide an AI service, and we don't train AI on your data. Lumen works fully without AI. If you add your own key from an AI provider, requests go directly from your browser to that provider, and their terms apply. (Crown Help itself, when AI answers launch, only uses our public website content.)

intents.title: Is Crown Help reading my chats?
intents.answer: Chats with me are kept without your name for 30 days so we can improve answers, then deleted. Please don't share personal health details here. If you send a message to our team, it's handled as an enquiry under our privacy notice.

intents.title: Security / was I hacked / suspicious email
intents.answer: We'll never ask for your password or card details by email. If you think someone has used your account, reset your password now, and email us straight away so we can check.

intents.title: What is MedLex?
intents.answer: MedLex helps you understand medical words by splitting them into parts you know: prefix + root + suffix (tachy + card + ia = fast heart). It has 26 modules, 1,480 terms and 56 illustrated guides, with spaced practice, word-part studios and pronunciation practice.

intents.title: What's free in MedLex?
intents.answer: The starter modules are free: word structure, vocabulary, prefixes and suffixes. The Crown Pass unlocks all 26 modules, the full term library and every illustrated guide.

intents.title: How do I study in MedLex? Where do I start?
intents.answer: Start with **Today**, then the **word structure** module: it teaches the method used everywhere else. After that, pick a body system. Use **Practice** a few minutes a day; spaced practice brings back words just before you'd forget them.

intents.title: What is the Learn / Learning Studio?
intents.answer: **Learn** opens the lesson library: curriculum lessons as slides, plus a visual atlas. You can write, highlight and draw on slides, and your notes stay in your browser. Locked lessons open with the Crown Pass.

intents.title: Pronunciation / audio not playing
intents.answer: Check your device isn't on silent and the volume is up, then tap play again. On iPhone, the ring/silent switch can mute web audio. If it still doesn't play, tell us the word and your device.

intents.title: A term or definition is wrong
intents.answer: Thank you for spotting it. Please send the term and what you think is wrong, and we'll check it and correct it.

intents.title: UK vs US spelling / terms
intents.answer: MedLex uses UK spelling and has a lesson on country differences that shows the US forms side by side (for example haem-/hem-, oedema/edema).

intents.title: Is MedLex good for clinical coders / OET / IELTS / international nurses?
intents.answer: Yes for building medical vocabulary: it's used by coders and international nurses learning medical English. It isn't an OET or IELTS course, but understanding terms by their parts helps with reading and listening tasks.

intents.title: What is Lumen?
intents.answer: Lumen helps you study your own material. Add PDFs, lecture slides or photos of notes, read and highlight them, turn what matters into recall cards, and review them with spaced practice. It has a focus timer, a planner, a board and a lab values reference. Your library stays on your device.

intents.title: What's free in Lumen vs the Crown Pass?
intents.answer: Lumen's study tools are free. The Crown Pass gives you unlimited sources, recall cards and the full focus planner.

intents.title: Where are my files stored? Are they uploaded?
intents.answer: Nothing is uploaded. Your files, notes and cards stay in this browser on this device, or in a folder on your computer if you connect one (Chrome and Edge). You can see what's using space under **Settings → Workspace storage**.

intents.title: "Could not be saved" / storage full
intents.answer:
Your browser's space or your chosen limit is full. Open **Settings → Workspace storage** and:
1. use **Make room** to remove large originals you no longer need (you can keep their notes and cards), or
2. raise your space limit, or
3. connect a folder on your computer (Chrome and Edge).
Back up first if in doubt.

intents.title: Back up / move Lumen to a new device
intents.answer: Use **Back up** in Workspace storage to save a backup file, then **Restore** it on the new device. Back up regularly: clearing your browser data removes the library.

intents.title: I lost my Lumen library / cards disappeared
intents.answer: I'm sorry, that's stressful. Lumen's library lives in the browser where you made it, so first check you're on the same device and browser (and not a private window). If you have a backup file, restore it from **Workspace storage**. If browser data was cleared and there's no backup, we can't recover it from our side, because we never hold a copy.
buttons: Email us if you need help

intents.title: How do I use AI in Lumen? / API key
intents.answer: Lumen works fully without AI. If you want AI help, add your own key from a provider in Lumen's settings. The key stays in your browser, and requests go straight to that provider, not through us. Lumen shows each provider's free-plan limits and privacy notes. AI answers can be wrong, so check them against your course materials.

intents.title: AI says limit reached / key error
intents.answer: That message comes from your AI provider, not Lumen. Usually the free plan's per-minute or daily limit is reached, or the key was copied incorrectly. Wait a minute, check the key, or look at your usage in the provider's dashboard.

intents.title: A PDF won't open / photo text not recognised
intents.answer:
Sorry about that. Try:
1. Make sure the PDF isn't password-protected.
2. For photos, use good light and a straight, sharp image.
3. Very large files may need more space: check Workspace storage.
Still not working? Tell us the file type and size (don't send the file if it contains personal details).

intents.title: What is Carecraft?
intents.answer: Carecraft builds everyday care skills in short bursts: a 60-second scenario a day, 30 short lessons, 32 practice activities and 18 toolkit job aids such as an SBAR handover builder. Topics include communication, safety, teamwork, escalation and handover. Scenarios are fictional.

intents.title: What's free in Carecraft?
intents.answer: The daily scenario and 6 lessons are free. The Crown Pass unlocks all 30 lessons, every activity and the full toolkit.

intents.title: Is Carecraft CPD / will my employer accept it?
intents.answer: Carecraft isn't accredited CPD. Many people still use a lesson as the basis for a reflective account. Check what your employer or regulator accepts. For staff training, ask us about a team pilot.

intents.title: Can I download the offline edition?
intents.answer: Yes. Carecraft has a downloadable offline edition you open in your browser without internet. Your progress stays in that file's browser storage, so export a backup before switching between the online and offline versions.

intents.title: My Carecraft progress is gone
intents.answer: I'm sorry about that. Carecraft saves in the browser where you used it, so check you're on the same device and browser, not a private window. If you exported a backup, import it from Settings. If browser data was cleared without a backup, we can't restore it from our side.

intents.title: I disagree with a scenario answer
say: in my trust we do it differently
intents.answer: Thanks for challenging it; that's good practice. Our scenarios teach general principles, and local policy always comes first. Send us the scenario and your reasoning, and we'll review it.

intents.title: How to use the Learning Studio / slides / pen tools
intents.answer: Every lesson has **Learn as slides**: a 14-slide journey with ideas, infographics, checks and a reflection. Press **A** for tools (pen, highlighter, shapes, text), **G** for an overview, **F** for full screen and **Esc** to close. Your notes and drawings are saved in your browser.

intents.title: What is Serein? Is it free?
intents.answer: Serein is free for everyone, with nothing to unlock. It has 15 short, private practices for before, during and after a shift: breathing, grounding, movement and reflection. Ten seconds is enough to start.

intents.title: Is my journal private? Is it monitored?
intents.answer: Yes, it's private. Serein's practices, mood check-ins and journal stay only in your browser on this device. Nothing is sent to us, and no one at the Academy can read them. Nothing is monitored.

intents.title: Is Serein therapy / can it help my anxiety?
intents.answer: Serein offers general relaxation and reflection practices. It isn't therapy, treatment or a crisis service. If you're struggling, please talk to your GP, occupational health or your employer's support service. In England you can call **NHS 111, option 2** for urgent mental health help.

intents.title: Crisis / distress
Burnout / work stress / a hard shift
intents.answer: That sounds like a heavy day. Serein has short practices made for exactly this, for after a shift. If you're feeling this way often, it's worth talking to occupational health, your manager or your GP: you deserve support too.

intents.title: Save Serein offline / install
intents.answer: Open Serein's settings and choose to save it for offline use. You can also add it to your home screen (Safari: Share → Add to Home Screen; Chrome/Edge: Install).

intents.title: What is the Gulf studio?
intents.answer: One studio for four nursing licensing exams: Saudi SNLE, Qatar DHP, Dubai DHA and Abu Dhabi DOH. It has 1,297 clinically reviewed practice questions, 67 clinical reasoning tools, 35 specialty dossiers, a bilingual glossary, and mock exams in tutor and exam modes with a review of misses. Original practice material, not official exam questions, and not endorsed by SCFHS, DHP, DHA or DOH.

intents.title: What's free?
intents.answer: 10 free questions for each exam, so you can try the studio before paying. The **Gulf Pass** unlocks everything for all four exams.

intents.title: Are these the real exam questions? / leaked questions / recalls
intents.answer: No. Our questions are original practice material written to match the exam's style and topics, not official or recalled exam questions, and we're not endorsed by any regulator. That protects you: using leaked material can risk your licence application.

intents.title: Will this guarantee I pass?
intents.answer: No course can honestly guarantee a pass, and our scores aren't a validated readiness assessment. What the studio does is help you practise reasoning on exam-style questions, and see where you're weak so you can focus.

intents.title: I'm taking more than one exam. Do I pay twice?
intents.answer: No. One Gulf Pass covers all four exams, and each keeps its own progress.

intents.title: How many questions / how long / pass mark of the SNLE (or DHA, DOH, Qatar)?
intents.answer: Each exam has its own guide with the published details. For example, the Saudi SNLE guide shows the number of questions, time and pass mark as last checked. Rules change, so always confirm with the regulator (SCFHS, DHP, DHA or DOH) when you book.

intents.title: Eligibility, DataFlow, Prometric, Mumaris, booking, licence application
intents.answer: Those steps belong to the regulator and their partners, so please follow the official guidance from SCFHS, DHP, DHA or DOH. Our free exam guides summarise the process and link to the official sources. We can help you prepare for the exam itself.

intents.title: Switch exam / my progress is on the wrong exam
intents.answer: Use the exam switcher at the top of the studio (Saudi, Qatar, Dubai, Abu Dhabi). Each exam keeps its own progress, so nothing is lost when you switch.

intents.title: Set my exam date / study plan
intents.answer: On **Today**, add your booking date and the studio suggests a daily pace. The date is saved on this device.

intents.title: Tutor mode vs exam mode
intents.answer: **Tutor mode** shows the answer and reasoning after each question: best for learning. **Exam mode** hides answers until the end and is timed: best for checking your speed and stamina.

intents.title: I think an answer is wrong
intents.answer: Thanks for checking carefully. Use **Report** on the question, or send us the question number and your reasoning (with a reference if you have one). A clinician reviews every report.

intents.title: Units: mg/dL vs mmol/L
intents.answer: Gulf exams can use either. The studio's lab references and glossary show both, and MedLex and Lumen's lab values reference help you convert. In the exam, read the units in the question carefully.

intents.title: How long is the Gulf Pass? When does it end?
say: how long is the gulf pass
intents.answer: 1, 3 or 6 months from purchase (US$29, US$50 or US$69). It's paid once, never renews, and your account page shows the end date.

intents.title: Progress not syncing between devices (Gulf)
intents.answer: Make sure you're signed in with the same account on both devices: progress saves to your account when signed in. Personal notes stay on the device where you wrote them. You can also use backup/import.

intents.title: Arabic button / bilingual
intents.answer: The studio is in English, with a bilingual glossary for key terms. Crown Help answers in English.

intents.title: What is Evinca?
intents.answer: Evinca is our independent, evidence-reviewed recognition programme for nurses, midwives, doctors, pharmacists, allied health professionals, educators and leaders. Share your story free; when you're ready, apply for a paid evidence review and get a public record anyone can verify.

intents.title: How much does Evinca cost?
intents.answer: A Spotlight Story is free. Fixed prices, the same in every country: US$9 to verify a monthly Spotlight (US$7 with three colleague confirmations), US$29 for a quarterly Distinction, and US$39 to US$149 for an annual Honor. Crown Pass members get 15% off review fees. The fee pays for review; it never guarantees selection.

intents.title: Is Evinca a licence / qualification? Can I put it after my name?
intents.answer: Evinca recognition is not a licence to practise, a regulatory registration, a clinical certification or an academic qualification. Evinca's FAQ explains how you can describe an honor accurately.

intents.title: Does paying buy an honor?
intents.answer: No. The fee pays for independent review, and the outcome can be "not yet". Honorees never pay for their record, badge or certificate.

intents.title: How do I nominate or thank a nurse?
say: say thank you to a nurse
intents.answer: On Evinca, choose **Nominate someone** (free, about five minutes, and we won't say it was you unless you want us to) or **Say thank you**.
buttons: Guide: how to thank a nurse

intents.title: Verify an honor
intents.answer: Use **Verify** on Evinca and enter the record number (for example EV-2026-000124). Each record shows the criteria, evidence reviewed, limits and current status.

intents.title: I disagree with my review decision / appeal / correction
intents.answer: I understand this matters. Evinca has a published appeals and corrections process. Please use it from your Evinca account, or email us with your record number and we'll route it to the review team.

intents.title: Hospitals / funding seats
intents.answer: Organisations can recognise staff with independent review and fund seats for others. Tell us about your organisation and we'll get back to you.

intents.title: Become a reviewer / editorial board
intents.answer: Evinca recruits reviewers who declare conflicts and follow a code of conduct. See **Become a reviewer** on Evinca, or email us with your background.

intents.title: What is the Green Belt toolkit?
intents.answer: An interactive Lean Six Sigma Green Belt for healthcare: 30 DMAIC tools you use on your own project, 9 live statistics engines, 10 simulations, a 66-question knowledge exam and a Certificate of Completion. Free to try with an account.

intents.title: Price / is it in the Crown Pass?
say: is green belt in crown pass
intents.answer: US$99 for 12 months, paid once (launch price until 31 January 2027, then US$149). It's a separate app with its own sign-in, not part of the Crown Pass, and the same price in every country.

dated.answer: US$149 for 12 months, paid once. It's a separate app with its own sign-in, not part of the Crown Pass, and the same price in every country.

intents.title: Is the certificate accredited? ASQ / IASSC?
intents.answer: You get a **Certificate of Completion** in your own name after passing the exam at 80%. It isn't an ASQ or IASSC certification; the toolkit includes exam prep if you plan to sit one of those separately.

intents.title: My Green Belt login doesn't work with my Academy account
say: green belt sign in not working
intents.answer: The Green Belt has its own sign-in, separate from your Academy account. Create a Green Belt account (it can use the same email), or use **Forgot your password?** on the Green Belt sign-in.

intents.title: Access code from my organisation
intents.answer: Create your account first, then choose **Redeem a code** from your name menu.

intents.title: My project work is gone / new computer
intents.answer: Your project work stays in the browser where you made it. Use **Export** to save your portfolio as a file and import it on the new device. If browser data was cleared without an export, we can't recover it from our side.

intents.title: Green Belt refund
intents.answer: A change-of-mind refund is available within 14 days. It also withdraws any Certificate of Completion issued for that purchase. Email us with your receipt number.

intents.title: Statistics question (how to read a control chart, Cpk...)
intents.answer: Each tool has a clinical worked example and the **LSS Guide** handbook explains it. Our free calculators also show how to read the result.

intents.title: Where are the free guides?
intents.answer: All free guides are on the Guides page: medical word parts, study skills (active recall, spaced repetition, slides to flashcards, exam week), Carecraft skills (SBAR, communication, safety, empathy, infection, reasoning), Serein, the Gulf exams and how to thank a nurse.

intents.title: Free QI calculators
intents.answer: Free tools: control chart calculator, process capability (Cpk) calculator, and sigma level / DPMO calculator. No account needed.

intents.title: App won't load / blank screen / stuck loading
intents.answer:
Sorry about that. Try, in order:
1. Refresh the page.
2. Check your internet connection.
3. Update your browser.
4. If it's installed as an app, close it fully and reopen it.
Still blank? Tell us the app, device and browser, and we'll look into it.

intents.title: Old version showing / changes not appearing
intents.answer: Your browser may be showing a saved copy. Close every tab of the app and reopen it; on a computer, a hard refresh (Ctrl+Shift+R, or Cmd+Shift+R on Mac) helps.

intents.title: Something looks broken / button doesn't work
intents.answer: Sorry about that. Tell me where it happened and what you expected, and I'll send it to our team with your device details. A screenshot helps (no personal details please).

intents.title: Accessibility: screen reader, text size, motion, dark mode
intents.answer: The apps work with screen readers and keyboard, follow your device's text size, and respect "reduce motion". There's a dark theme in the menu. If something blocks you, please tell us: accessibility problems are a priority for us.

intents.title: Sound on the home page / tour audio
intents.answer: The home page story has a **Sound off/on** button; the tours have their own play button. Sound is always off until you choose it.

intents.title: Private / incognito browsing loses my progress
intents.answer: Private windows delete everything when you close them, including app progress. Use a normal window to keep your work.

intents.title: Patient-specific or clinical advice
intents.answer: I can't give advice about a real patient or person, and our apps are for learning only. Please follow your local policy and speak to the clinician in charge, a pharmacist, or NHS 111 if it's about your own health. If it helps your learning, I can point you to the related topic in MedLex or Carecraft.

intents.title: Medication calculation help (as a learner)
intents.answer: For learning, Gulf Region Nursing and Carecraft include practice on calculations and reasoning. For a real patient, always use your local policy, a second checker and the pharmacist.

intents.title: Do my assignment / write my essay
intents.answer: I can't write assignments, but Lumen can help you study your own sources, and our study guides cover active recall and planning.

intents.title: Partnership / reseller / affiliate / sponsorship
intents.answer: Thanks for your interest. Please tell us about your organisation and what you have in mind, and the founder will reply.

intents.title: Press / interview
intents.answer: Thanks for getting in touch. Send your outlet, deadline and questions, and we'll reply as soon as we can.

intents.title: Jobs / write content / review questions for you
intents.answer: Thank you. Send us a short note about your background and what you'd like to contribute. Clinical reviewers and educators are especially welcome.

intents.title: Feature request / suggestion
intents.answer: Thank you, we read every suggestion. Tell me what you'd like and why it would help, and I'll pass it to the team.

intents.title: Praise / thanks
intents.answer: Thank you, that genuinely means a lot to a small team. If you're happy for us to quote you, we'd love a line by email.

intents.title: Didn't understand
intents.answer: Sorry, I didn't quite follow. Could you say it another way, or choose a topic?

intents.title: No answer found (second miss in a row)
intents.answer: I'm not certain about that one, and I'd rather not guess. Our team will answer by email, within 5 working days.

intents.title: Ask for a human
intents.answer: Of course. We don't have a phone line, but a person reads every email. Send your message here and you'll get a reference number.

intents.title: Off-topic / abuse / trying to break the rules
intents.answer: I can only help with Healthcare Crown Academy apps, plans and accounts.
